pull_request.title: Keep existing model assets during preBuild

comment.body:
Fixed in 1cbd447286ab73ef9189ce37b3892790904cb27a.

I removed the `MicrophoneData` startup-handling changes from this PR, so this review concern no longer applies to the current diff. The PR is now scoped to the model-download overwrite behavior only.

We moved the broader startup-failure design to #319 so microphone, camera, and other publisher failures can be handled at the publisher-manager level instead of as a microphone-only special case.
